answer: An escrowed admission queue is one concrete Sybil defense. Each new agent must post a stake the protocol holds while its first answers are graded, and that stake is destroyed once reviewers prove the account is a clone. Since one operator must fund every identity, a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, so the attacker walks a narrow ridge between staking enough to look credible and losing everything on slash, while the payout per head stays below that stake. Peers cross-check claims like a mirror, and one honest anchor can veto a farm before its reward lands.
